LANCER_HT.Keybind.Toggle.Name: Toggle hover translation
LANCER_HT.Keybind.Toggle.Hint: Switches the hints on and off mid-session, including where no scene is open.
LANCER_HT.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable hover hints
LANCER_HT.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Show a translation on hover. Per-client, so each player decides. Toggle it quickly from the scene controls or with the hotkey (Alt+T by default).
LANCER_HT.Settings.Trigger.Name: Trigger
LANCER_HT.Settings.Trigger.Hint: Show on plain hover, or only while a modifier key is held.
LANCER_HT.Settings.Delay.Name: Dwell delay (ms)
LANCER_HT.Settings.Delay.Hint: How long the cursor must rest on a paragraph before the hint appears.
LANCER_HT.Settings.Glossary.Name: Term glossary
LANCER_HT.Settings.Glossary.Hint: List Lancer terms found in the paragraph at the top of the hint.
LANCER_HT.Settings.Provider.Name: Translation service
LANCER_HT.Settings.Provider.Hint: Who translates the whole paragraph. Without a service only the glossary works.
LANCER_HT.Settings.Endpoint.Name: LibreTranslate endpoint
LANCER_HT.Settings.Endpoint.Hint: For example https://libretranslate.com or your own server. It must send CORS headers — the request leaves the player's browser.
LANCER_HT.Settings.ApiKey.Name: API key
LANCER_HT.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Required for Google, optional for LibreTranslate. Note: this is a world setting, so the key reaches every player's browser.
LANCER_HT.Settings.TargetLang.Name: Target language
LANCER_HT.Settings.TargetLang.Hint: Language code passed to the translation service, ru by default.
LANCER_HT.Settings.MaxChars.Name: Paragraph length cap
LANCER_HT.Settings.MaxChars.Hint: Longer text is truncated so a whole sheet is never sent to the translator.
